name: dsh-desktop
description: Windows desktop wrapper for DeepSeek Harness Web UI
author: DSH Desktop contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --pretty false
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:node-runtime && npm run prepare:dsh-runtime && npm run build:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.release:github: npm run prepare:node-runtime && npm run prepare:dsh-runtime && npm run build:icon && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.verify:bundled-node: npm run prepare:node-runtime && npm run prepare:dsh-runtime && tsx scripts/verify-bundled-node.ts
